title: Susan McCasland's 911 call about her husband

tellings.quote: I have some indication that he must have planned not to be found.

plain: Susan McCasland says that in 2026, in Albuquerque, New Mexico, she called 911 to report her husband missing. In the recording she tells the dispatcher, "I have some indication that he must have planned not to be found." Her call is played on the show as part of Michels's look at why top American scientists are going missing.
